name: mfi_paper_candidate
purpose: Replication-oriented comparison; not an exact replication

source.title: An Online Fragmentation-Aware GPU Scheduler for Multi-Tenant MIG-based Clouds
source.table_i: A100 MIG profiles, Slice No., Instances, legal Index values
source.table_ii: Uniform, skew-small, skew-big and bimodal profile probabilities

profile_stream.distribution: one of the four exact Table II distributions
profile_stream.load_axis: sum of Table I Slice No. values divided by 7 * gpu_count

temporal_model.T_interpretation: number of sampled jobs in the trace needed to reach the scalar offered-load target

important_qualification: This is not an exact replication: the paper does not release original executable code and leaves some arrival, duration and resource scalarization details underspecified. The separate compute/memory occupancy model and BF/WF residual scoring in this repository are explicit operationalizations. Do not claim bit-for-bit reproduction.
